asked.note: Ask Chuck is faster: about 2 seconds per answer. Ours took about 7 to 19 seconds while it checked prices and hours against your pages.

questions.q: What are the Kirkland hours today?
questions.theirs: Yo, in Kirkland, we're open today from 11 AM to 10:30 PM. Come through and get your smash on! Address is 9739 NE 119th Way, Kirkland, WA 98034. Chuck Approved!
questions.ours:
Kirkland is open today, Wednesday, from **11:00 am to 10:30 pm**. It’s open now.

📍 9739 NE 119th Way, Kirkland, WA 98034
questions.outcome: Both correct. Chuck answers in about 2 seconds; ours takes several seconds longer.

questions.q: Do you have a gluten free bun or anything for someone with a gluten allergy?
questions.theirs: We don't have a gluten free bun, but we do offer gluten-friendly fries! Just a heads up, everything is made in a shared kitchen with shared fryers, so cross-contact with gluten is possible. If you have a gluten allergy, it's best to confirm with the store before ordering. Give 'em a call at (425) 553-1531. Keep it Secret. Keep it Messy!
questions.ours:
SBK doesn’t publish a gluten-free bun. The **SBK Smash Protein Bowl** is a bunless option, but I can’t confirm it’s suitable for a gluten allergy.

Shared grills and fryers can cause cross-contact, and sauces and other ingredients may contain allergens. Please flag the allergy before ordering and call **Kirkland at (425) 553-1531** to check current ingredients and preparation. See the [food allergy guide](https://secretburgerkitchen.com/guide-to-food-allergy-choices/).
questions.outcome: Both are careful and send the guest to the store. Chuck mentions gluten-friendly fries, which we could not find on SBK's site; ours stays with what SBK publishes and links SBK's allergy guide.

questions.q: Can I book the food truck for a company event of about 60 people in Kirkland next month? How do I get a quote?
questions.theirs: I don't handle bookings, but you can reach out to the Kirkland location directly at (425) 553-1531 to discuss your event and get a quote. They'll help you out with all the details. Smash. Eat. Repeat!
questions.ours:
Yes, SBK Mobile handles private event bookings. For a quote for your **December company event in Kirkland for about 60 people**, call the truck team at **(206) 759-0000**. They can discuss the date, travel and pricing; availability isn’t confirmed.

If you prefer, I can help pass along your request for a quote. What’s the event date and the best phone number or email for follow-up?
questions.outcome: SBK's site says truck events and catering go through the truck team at (206) 759-0000. Chuck sends this 60-person event to the Kirkland store line and records nothing; ours gives the truck team's number and offers to take the request.

questions.q: Is the Renton location open yet?
questions.theirs: Not yet, my friend! The Renton location is set to open in December 2026. Keep your eyes peeled for those delicious SBK flavors coming your way! In the meantime, you can hit up our Seattle location just a mile away at 554 Broadway, Seattle, WA 98122. Chuck Approved!
questions.ours:
Not yet. The Renton location at **202 SW 43rd St** is opening in **December 2026**; an exact day hasn’t been published.

The nearest open SBK is the **Auburn food truck**, about 10 miles away, at 102 15th St NE.
questions.outcome: Both have the December 2026 opening right. Chuck calls the Seattle store "a mile away"; it is about 16 miles by road. Ours names the Auburn truck, about 10 miles away.

questions.q: How much is a double smash burger?
questions.theirs: I can't quote prices, but you can check out the live prices by hitting the Order Now button on our site. The Double Smash is packed with flavor, so you know it's worth it! Smash. Eat. Repeat!
questions.ours:
The Double Smash is **$11.99 before tax** on the [truck’s online menu](https://order.toasttab.com/online/secret-burger-kitchen-food-truck-13115-southeast). It doesn’t include a side.

Each store’s own Toast page shows its current price, which may differ.
questions.outcome: Chuck doesn't give prices. Ours quotes the published $11.99 from the truck's online menu and says store prices can differ.

questions.q: Do you take reservations for a group of 12 at the Kirkland location?
questions.theirs: I don't handle reservations, but you can call the Kirkland location at (425) 553-1531 to ask about booking for your group. They'll be happy to help you out! Keep it Secret. Keep it Messy!
questions.ours:
SBK doesn’t publish a reservation system or group-seating policy. For a group of 12, call **Kirkland at (425) 553-1531** to ask about dining in.

You can also [order ahead online](https://order.toasttab.com/online/secret-burger-kitchen-kirkland-9739-ne-119th-way) for pickup.
questions.outcome: Both send the group to the Kirkland store phone, which is right because the site doesn't publish a reservation system. Ours also links ordering ahead.

questions.q: I want to apply for a job at Kirkland, who do I contact?
questions.theirs: You can reach out to the Kirkland location directly at (425) 553-1531 for job inquiries. They'll get you set up with all the info you need to join the SBK tribe! Chuck Approved!
questions.ours:
Apply through the [online job application](https://secretburgerkitchen.com/jobs/) and select **Kirkland**. It takes about two minutes, and a resume is optional.

For a question about the location, you can also call Kirkland at **(425) 553-1531**.
questions.outcome: SBK has a two-minute online application. Chuck sends applicants to the store phone; ours links the application.

questions.q: Is the food truck in Kent or Auburn now?
questions.theirs: The truck moved to Auburn! It's now at the Economy Inn, 102 15th St NE, Auburn, WA 98002. Thank you, Kent, for all the love and support! New spot. Same SBK flavor. You can catch us there daily from 11:30 AM to 9 PM!
questions.ours:
The food truck is in **Auburn**, not Kent. It moved today, November 11.

Find it at **Economy Inn, 102 15th St NE, Auburn, WA 98002**, open daily from **11:30 am to 9:00 pm**.
questions.outcome: Both correct. Chuck had the move the same day. (Chuck's own error message still lists "the Kent truck".)

questions.q: What wing flavors do you have?
questions.theirs: The homepage and wings page list all eight flavors.
questions.ours:
Our crispy wings come in eight flavors, from mild to hot:

- Naked
- SBK Dry Rub
- Maharaji Dry Rub
- Garlic Parmesan
- Lemon Pepper
- Caribbean Jerk
- Hot Honey
- Buffalo

See the full [wings lineup](https://secretburgerkitchen.com/wings/).

questions.theirs: The menu and location pages mention the Impossible Smash; the site has a plant-based ordering guide.
questions.ours:
Yes! The **Impossible Smash** has a plant-based patty. The bunless SBK Smash Protein Bowl is another build-your-own option—ask the store about a meat-free build.

Check the toppings and sauces for your preferences, and ask about shared cooking equipment if that matters to you. [See the menu](https://secretburgerkitchen.com/menu/).
questions.outcome: Both point to the Impossible Smash; ours also mentions the bunless bowl.

questions.q: Are you open right now in Seattle?
questions.theirs: The locations page lists Seattle's hours; the visitor has to work out whether it's open now.
questions.ours:
Yes! **Seattle Capitol Hill is open now.** Today’s hours are 11:00 am–10:30 pm.

📍 554 Broadway, Seattle, WA 98122
questions.outcome: Ours says whether the store is open now and gives today's hours.

questions.q: How much would it cost to cater lunch for about 25 people at our office in Seattle?
questions.theirs: Catering buttons open each store's ezCater menu; there is no headcount estimate on the site.
questions.ours:
For about 25 people, **Seattle drop-off catering estimates** are:

- **25 Executive Boxes:** $487.50 for individually packaged lunches.
- **4 Event Burger Bars:** $440 for 32 servings.

Add **$20 for delivery**. Both meet the $100 delivery minimum. These are estimates before tax and tip, not quotes. Order through [Seattle catering on ezCater](https://www.ezcater.com/catering/secret-burger-kitchen-4).

For an on-site food truck instead, the truck team provides a separate quote at **(206) 759-0000**.
questions.outcome: Ours gives an estimate for 25 people from the published ezCater prices, with the delivery fee and the order link.

questions.q: We don't need the truck, just drop-off catering for 60 people at our Kirkland office next Friday. What would that run?
questions.theirs: Same ezCater menus; the visitor builds the order to see a total.
questions.ours:
For 60 people in Kirkland, the published estimates are:

- **Executive Boxes:** $1,170 for 60 individually packaged boxes, or **$1,190 with delivery**.
- **Event Burger Bars:** $880 for eight bars (64 servings), or **$900 with delivery**.

These are estimates before tax and tip, not quotes. Kirkland delivery is $20 with a $100 order minimum. Order through [Kirkland catering on ezCater](https://www.ezcater.com/catering/secret-burger-kitchen-5).

I can also pass a request to the catering team for a quote. What email or phone number should they use to follow up?
questions.outcome: Ours gives estimates for 60 people with and without delivery, plus the Kirkland ezCater link.

questions.q: I'd like to book the food truck for my daughter's graduation party on June 13, 2027 in Auburn, about 80 people.
questions.theirs: The truck page lists a phone number. There's no booking or catering request form for the truck.
questions.ours:
The SBK Mobile team can provide a quote for your daughter’s graduation party in Auburn on June 13, 2027, for about 80 guests. Availability and pricing aren’t published.

Would you like to share a phone number or email for follow-up? You can also call the truck team at **(206) 759-0000**.
questions.outcome: Ours takes the date, headcount, place and phone number and sends the request to the team.

questions.q: Is the Lynnwood location open this weekend?
questions.theirs: The site says Lynnwood opens February 2027.
questions.ours:
No, Lynnwood won’t be open this weekend, November 14–15. It’s scheduled to open in **February 2027**; an exact opening date hasn’t been published.

In the meantime, you can visit [Kirkland](https://secretburgerkitchen.com/locations/kirkland/) or [Seattle Capitol Hill](https://secretburgerkitchen.com/locations/seattle/).
questions.outcome: Both correct. Ours also suggests nearby open stores.

questions.q: My son has a peanut allergy. Are the shakes safe for him?
questions.theirs: There's no allergen chart. A blog guide explains cross-contact and says to ask the team.
questions.ours:
I can’t confirm that the shakes are safe for your son. Shakes and toppings can contain allergens, and shared equipment or preparation areas can cause cross-contact.

Please flag his peanut allergy before ordering and call the location you plan to visit to check current ingredients and preparation:

- Tacoma: (253) 507-8653
- Seattle Capitol Hill: (206) 556-3401
- Kirkland: (425) 553-1531
- SBK Mobile truck: (206) 759-0000

Here’s SBK’s [food allergy guide](https://secretburgerkitchen.com/guide-to-food-allergy-choices/).
questions.outcome: Ours won't call the shakes safe. It explains cross-contact, gives each store's phone and links SBK's allergy guide.

questions.q: I got the wrong order at Kirkland last night. Can I get a refund?
questions.theirs: No refund policy is published. The contact form and store phones are the routes.
questions.ours:
I’m sorry you got the wrong order. SBK doesn’t publish a refund policy, so I can’t confirm whether a refund is available.

Please call the Kirkland store at **(425) 553-1531**. You can also use the [contact form](https://secretburgerkitchen.com/contact/) or call the main line at **(800) 970-1766**.
questions.outcome: Ours doesn't promise a refund and gives the Kirkland phone and the contact form.

questions.q: Is the Kirkland store open at 12:30 am on Saturday night?
questions.theirs: The locations page lists Kirkland as open until 1:00 am on Friday and Saturday nights.
questions.ours: Yes. Kirkland is open until **1:00 am after Saturday night**, so it’s open at 12:30 am early Sunday. Its Saturday hours are 11:00 am–1:00 am.
questions.outcome: Ours handles the after-midnight hours correctly: open at 12:30 am early Sunday.
